summary: Iter-41 Phase 15 (15-widget allow-list + Notes/Blog/Polls/Videos/Music/Podcasts overhaul). BACKEND: 13/13 pytest PASS — allow-list strips deprecated types on PATCH; Notes (VIP 500/stealth ∞) + Blog (VIP 2000/stealth ∞) + Videos (4) + Music/Podcasts (10) caps enforced with 400s; public profile filter clean; polls vote round-trip + idempotent upsert + public GET works; sounds/by-user returns tracks; migrate_strip_deprecated_widgets is idempotent (no churn on 2nd boot). FRONTEND: BLOCKED by two critical bugs introduced by the WidgetBody refactor — (1) ProfileWidgetBodies.jsx imported a non-existent symbol `mediaUrl` from @/lib/mediaUrl (real export is `resolveMediaUrl`) causing webpack to show a 'Compiled with problems' overlay across the entire app on first load; testing agent applied an import-alias fix to unblock testing. (2) Profile.jsx SortableWidget renders `w.size[0].toUpperCase()` unguarded at line 169 — when any widget lacks `size` (which happens for the cleanup payload main agent's curl set, AND will happen for newly-added widgets via the multi-select picker if `size` isn't defaulted in onPickMany) the page throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 0)' and renders the React error overlay. Testing agent re-seeded tftwo with `size:'medium'` to unblock further checks. After those mitigations the picker modal did NOT open in our automation (clicking 'ADD NEW WIDGET' and 'EDIT WIDGETS' did not surface [data-testid='add-widget-picker'] tiles), so multi-select / char-counter / polls-vote / radar UI flows could NOT be verified end-to-end. Older pytest test_profile_widgets_top8_above_myfeed.py has 3 expected failures (FOUNDER_WIDGETS no longer includes 'merch'/'custom' per Phase 15 spec — that test file's hard-coded order list is now outdated and must be updated by main agent).

ui_bugs.issue: Imports `mediaUrl` from @/lib/mediaUrl which does NOT export that symbol (available: resolveMediaUrl, isPlayableMediaUrl, probeMediaUrl, markMediaUrlBroken). Causes app-wide 'Compiled with problems' overlay on first load. Testing agent applied import-alias mitigation; main agent should decide whether to keep the alias or refactor callers to use resolveMediaUrl directly.

`{w.size[0].toUpperCase()}` crashes when w.size is undefined — happens for widgets seeded/PATCHed without a size field and likely for newly-added widgets via AddWidgetPicker.onPickMany if size isn't defaulted. Throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 0)' and shows React error overlay. Guard with `(w.size||'medium')[0].toUpperCase()` AND ensure onPickMany sets size='medium' on new items.

Could not open the multi-select widget library modal via 'ADD NEW WIDGET' tile or 'EDIT WIDGETS' header button in automation — modal [data-testid='add-widget-picker'] never appeared. Either the trigger button lacks a data-testid or the click target is wrapped/intercepted. Main agent should add data-testid on the trigger (e.g. 'open-widget-picker') so tests can reliably open the library, and verify the trigger actually toggles the open state.
ui_bugs.selector: Add New Widget tile / Edit Widgets button

critical_code_review_comments: Backend Phase 15 implementation is solid: allow-list, caps, polls upsert, public filter, sounds-by-user, idempotent boot migration — all verified by 13 pytest cases.

Frontend Profile.jsx WidgetBody refactor was NOT smoke-tested before handoff — both bugs surface on the very first /profile load (compile-error overlay and SortableWidget crash). Recommend main agent run `yarn build` or open /profile after any large refactor.

All char-limit error messages include the cap number in the detail string, which is useful for surfacing to the UI.

rca of the issue: (1) ProfileWidgetBodies.jsx import bug: agent imported the lib by its presumed default export name `mediaUrl` instead of the real `resolveMediaUrl`. Webpack flags this as a non-fatal warning at compile time but the dev overlay aggressively shows it as 'Compiled with problems', blocking the UI. Repro: any unauthenticated visit to /. (2) Profile.jsx crash: w.size[0] is called unguarded. Repro: PATCH any widget without a 'size' field (or fresh widget added through onPickMany if it doesn't default size), then load /profile in edit mode — React error overlay appears. Mitigation while testing: aliased import + curl-seeded tftwo with size='medium'.
